compile_note: PCC_NO_BUILTIN=1 for every vendored unit (pcc's -fno-builtin). Optimization level is per file: the mem primitives (bzero/memcpy/memmove/memset) need -O0 or LLVM rewrites their bodies into the primitive being defined; the scan helpers MUST NOT use -O0 because a double return value is lost there (BUG-P1-CC-O0-DOUBLE-RETURN-LOST).

local_patches.ctype/isdigit.c: locale variant (__isdigit_l / weak_alias isdigit_l) dropped: same reason
local_patches.ctype/isspace.c: locale variant (__isspace_l) dropped: needs musl's locale layer, never called by the runtime
local_patches.internal/atomic.h: replaced by a portable a_clz_64/a_clz_32 subset: upstream atomic.h pulls musl's per-architecture closure, and fma only needs the leading-zero count
local_patches.internal/exp_data.h: features.h include repointed to the vendored shim
local_patches.internal/floatscan.c: long double -> double (darwin-arm64 long double IS double; pcc's long-double return ABI is unimplemented and returned garbage)
local_patches.internal/libm.h: replaced by a pow/scan-closure subset: upstream pulls endian.h, fp_arch.h and the long-double layout machinery; this keeps the double bit-cast, eval/barrier and error-path declarations with upstream semantics
local_patches.internal/pcc_musl_features.h: local no-op definitions for musl's hidden/weak/weak_alias macros
local_patches.internal/pow_data.h: features.h include repointed to the vendored shim
local_patches.internal/stdio_impl.h: replaced by a minimal scan-only FILE declaration (upstream pulls musl's syscall layer)
local_patches.math/copysign.c: musl libm.h include replaced by <math.h>/<stdint.h> (pure bit manipulation; avoids musl's endian.h/fp_arch.h closure)
local_patches.math/fma.c: ASUINT64 compound literal replaced by a static inline with a named union (pcc's parser lacks compound literals)
local_patches.stdlib/strtod.c: long double -> double (same reason; strtof/strtod/strtold all become double-precision, which matches the platform)
local_patches.string/memmove.c: non-overlap memcpy fast path removed; the existing word/byte loops cover it (llvm.memcpy intrinsic would be self-referential)
local_patches.string/memrchr.c: weak_alias(__memrchr, memrchr) replaced by a plain wrapper
local_patches.string/strchr.c: added musl-internal prototype (pcc implicit-decl truncation guard)
local_patches.string/strchrnul.c: weak_alias(__strchrnul, strchrnul) replaced by a plain wrapper (no GNU alias attribute in pcc)
local_patches.string/strrchr.c: added musl-internal prototype (pcc implicit-decl truncation guard)

pcc_authored.internal/pcc_scan_uflow.c: not musl: fail-closed __uflow stub; the vendored scanners are used only on the strto* string path where no FILE refill can happen
